AIPrep_Assessment_Engine_Contract.purpose: [CORE ENGINE 1: ASSESSMENT ENGINE] Pure workflow state machine contract (START, SUBMIT, CANCEL rules). ZERO DB / ZERO Network Calls.

architecture.principle: The Assessment Orchestrator handles external interactions and persistence. The Assessment Engine validates input, applies assessment business rules, and returns the resulting assessment state.

responsibilities: Validate testing results provided to the engine

status_rules: An assessment must be IN_PROGRESS before it can be submitted.
Submission changes the assessment status from IN_PROGRESS to EVALUATING.
Evaluation completion changes the status from EVALUATING to COMPLETED.
Evaluation failure changes the status from EVALUATING to FAILED.
A completed assessment cannot be submitted again.
A failed assessment cannot be submitted again.
An assessment cancellation is allowed only while the assessment is IN_PROGRESS.
question_rules: Questions are selected according to the assessment question-selection rules.
A question must not be repeated until all eligible questions in the applicable category have been used.
Question retrieval and persistence are handled by the Assessment Orchestrator.
